ryan: Hi all  Day 1 q Where do I post: onboarding setup stuff vs team/product questions? Also getting hit by CI and deploy pings. Quick sanity check on best practices for threading and muting noisy bots? :slightly_smiling_face:

Tara: Welcome Ryan! Short rules I use: 1) onboarding / access / hardware = #new-hires (so others can search answers). 2) infra/VPN/laptop access = #help (infra) or DM the oncall/IT for urgent. 3) product/code/design = your team channel (e.g., #eng or #product). Keep cross-posting to a minimum  mention where else you posted if you do.

ryan: For the CI spams - want to silence noise but still get pages for failures. How do I do that without losing important alerts?

sam_it: Two quick options: 1) Channel-level: click channel name -> Notifications -> Mute (silences non-mentions). 2) Bot-level: open the bot's subscription message and click "unsubscribe" or run `/ci-bot settings` (many bots support `subscribe:critical` or `alerts:pages-only`). If you still want pages, keep `@oncall` subscriptions and unsubscribe your user-level alerts.

Tara: Also use Slack's Notification Schedule: Preferences -> Notifications -> Notification schedule and set your "working hours" so you don't get noise overnight. If you need heads-down, `/dnd 90m` works great.

dev-ops-bot: Provisioning note: New user ryan added to infra SSO group. VPN profile created.

ryan: Nice. Any etiquette on @channel/@here?

Tara: Avoid @channel unless it's a major outage or company/team-wide pre-agreed announcement. Use @here for immediate attention in-office hours only. For urgent operational things, ping `@oncall` instead of a broad @channel. When posting, include a 1-line header: e.g., `Help: VPN auth failing (SSO 401)` so folks can skim.

sam_it: Small pro tip for troubleshooting: run this to confirm SSO token: ```curl -sS -I https://onboard.redwood.io/me | grep Set-Cookie``` If you see missing cookie, re-login via SSO portal.

peopleops: Welcome! For badge/equipment requests DM me full name + shipping address. HR/payroll questions go in the People Ops portal (link pinned in #new-hires).

ryan: Threading question: if I have a follow-up after it's resolved, should I append to the same thread or start fresh?

Tara: If it's the same root issue, reply in-thread. If the topic changes (e.g., VPN fixed but now need access to a repo), start a new message with a clear header and link back to the previous thread if helpful. Also mark resolved threads with a reaction :white_check_mark: and optionally post `Resolved: <short note>` so searchers find the outcome.

ryan: Great, this helps a lot. I'll add my intro to #introductions and pin the onboarding checklist to my sidebar. Thanks! :tada:
